claims.pass_condition: Inventory reads an explicit external cache without creating an absent root or changing any entry.
claims.primary_surface: Absent-root and populated-root filesystem observations before and after inventory
claims.counterevidence: Inventory creates a directory, changes an entry, or runs from candidate execution.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: CLI process inventory followed by exact entry-count readback
claims.observed_evidence: An absent root remained absent and emitted a sealed empty inventory; a three-entry CLI cache remained at three entries after inventory.

claims.pass_condition: Inventory has finite entry/file ceilings and returns LIMIT_EXCEEDED rather than traversing past them.
claims.primary_surface: Focused execution with a one-entry scan ceiling over three entries
claims.counterevidence: The inventory silently scans beyond the declared ceiling or hashes all artifact bytes as a prerequisite.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Static inspection of fixed maximum limits and lstat-only logical-byte accounting
claims.observed_evidence: The one-entry fixture returned LIMIT_EXCEEDED; runtime caps are 100000 entries and 1000000 files and inventory does not hash artifact content.

claims.pass_condition: Entry count, logical bytes, and observed filesystem age independently select oldest-first candidates with explicit reasons.
claims.primary_surface: Three controlled-mtime entries evaluated under separate policies
claims.counterevidence: One budget masks another, ordering changes for the same inventory, or a selection has no reason.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Exact candidate key and reason assertions
claims.observed_evidence: Logical-byte pressure selected the oldest exact entry; the combined policy separately emitted FILESYSTEM_AGE and ENTRY_COUNT reasons in oldest-first order.

claims.pass_condition: Every exact protected key is excluded from candidates even when satisfying policy would otherwise require deleting it.
claims.primary_surface: Count and age pressure with the middle entry protected
claims.counterevidence: A protected key appears as a candidate or policy satisfaction is claimed by silently ignoring its age.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: READY_WITH_LIMITS result when the protected entry alone violates age policy
claims.observed_evidence: The protected key remained outside both candidates and deletion outcomes; a protected age violation produced READY_WITH_LIMITS rather than fake satisfaction.

claims.pass_condition: Planning emits a canonical sealed dry-run and apply reproduces the official plan before accepting its candidates.
claims.primary_surface: Canonical digest validation plus filesystem no-change checks
claims.counterevidence: Planning deletes state or a resealed arbitrary candidate substitution is accepted.
claims.observed_evidence: The dry-run was sealed and left all entries present; a validly resealed protected-key substitution returned PROPOSAL_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE.

claims.pass_condition: No deletion occurs without both explicit apply authority and the exact proposal digest.
claims.primary_surface: Missing-explicit and wrong-digest API and CLI attempts
claims.counterevidence: Either partial credential deletes an entry or creates an absent root.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Filesystem existence checks for every entry after refusal
claims.observed_evidence: NOT_REQUESTED, NOT_APPROVED, and APPROVAL_MISMATCH paths deleted nothing; the unrequested CLI path created no cache root.

claims.pass_condition: Any new, removed, or changed cache entry after planning invalidates the approved snapshot before deletion.
claims.primary_surface: Separate child-process publication between plan and apply
claims.counterevidence: The old proposal deletes any originally selected key after the inventory changed.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Post-refusal existence checks for every original entry
claims.observed_evidence: A separate publisher added one entry; application returned STALE and every originally selected entry remained present.

claims.pass_condition: Exact approval deletes only official proposal candidates through the link-refusing selective invalidation boundary.
claims.primary_surface: Approved two-candidate application over a three-entry cache
claims.counterevidence: The protected key disappears, an undeclared path is targeted, or an invalidation is not sealed.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Each outcome binds its exact invalidation receipt digest
claims.observed_evidence: Two candidates returned REMOVED with valid invalidation digests; the protected third key remained present.

claims.pass_condition: Application inventories again after deletion and recomputes policy satisfaction from observed remaining state.
claims.counterevidence: Receipt claims success without observing absence or reports predicted rather than actual usage.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: CLI application in a separate process
claims.observed_evidence: The application receipt reported one observed remaining entry and policy_satisfied true; the CLI route independently reproduced two removals and one protected remainder.

claims.pass_condition: Undeclared content, links, special files, active publishers, and exhausted scan budgets cannot become automatic deletion candidates.
claims.primary_surface: Extra-file and active-publisher fixtures plus scan-limit execution
claims.counterevidence: Any such layout produces an applicable deletion proposal.
claims.observed_evidence: An undeclared file and an active publisher each produced REVIEW_REQUIRED and HELD; scan exhaustion produced LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

claims.pass_condition: A user-owned persisted policy authorizes a declared schedule without hiding deletion proposals or receipts.
claims.counterevidence: Retention runs merely because a cache exists or a candidate executes.
claims.observed_evidence: No policy is persisted and nothing schedules retention; every plan and apply is an explicit standalone action.

claims.pass_condition: Validated run ledgers are scanned read-only and their live cache keys become a sealed protected reference set.
claims.counterevidence: Unverified files grant protection authority or a live validated reference is omitted.
claims.observed_evidence: Exact protected keys work, but the caller must currently supply them; no run-ledger discovery adapter exists.

claims.pass_condition: Named large-cache workloads stay within declared wall-time, memory, and I/O budgets across repeated runs.
claims.primary_surface: Measured telemetry under representative cache sizes and file distributions
claims.counterevidence: Traversal cost or memory use exceeds the named budget before scan limits stop it.
claims.observed_evidence: Work is structurally bounded and content hashing is avoided, but no representative timing or memory benchmark was run.
